Delhi Police Warned CJP Organizers Over Protest Crowd Management

Delhi Police informed CJP protest organizers at Jantar Mantar about insufficient crowd management and the presence of "criminal elements" in the gathering. Police warned that more volunteers were needed to maintain order. The CJP's core committee is scheduled to meet on August 5th to discuss future strategies. Some coverage noted the protests involved defiance, chaos, and repression, while others highlighted the role of Gen Z in collective action and the need for accountability.
